source_title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 512GB plunges by $472 in one of its best deals ever
source_excerpt:

Big-screen phone fans have a strong option on the table right now. The Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is built for people who want plenty of space for videos, games, photos, and work, and there’s a solid deal on Amazon that makes it easier to grab.
Amazon has the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (512GB) down to $1,127, which is $472 off its $1,599 recommended retail price. That’s a 30% discount relative to the RRP, and just $7 off the all-time low price. It also carries a 4.6-star Amazon rating, which should give bargain hunters a bit more confidence.
The phone itself has the kind of setup you’d expect from a premium 2026 flagship. You get 12GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, though there’s no microSD card slot for expansion. Up front, there’s a large 6.9-inch AMOLED display with a 3120 x 1440 resolution and a 120Hz-class refresh rate for smoother scrolling and motion.
Samsung powers it with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chip, which is described as delivering very strong overall speed. Around the back, the camera system is led by a 200MP main sensor, plus an ultrawide lens and dual telephoto lenses for more zoom options. A 5,000mAh battery rounds things out, with strong endurance for a large flagship phone.
If you’ve been waiting for a deal on a top-tier Android phone with a huge display, big storage, and a flexible camera setup, this looks like a great time to buy. You can check out the offer on Amazon here .
